description: This Java source file defines a utility class `ShareDividendsTransactionHelper` that provides helper methods for managing share dividends transactions in integration tests for the Fineract project. It includes methods for creating, posting commands to, and retrieving dividend details via REST API calls, utilizing the RestAssured library for HTTP requests.

classes.name: ShareDividendsTransactionHelper
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods to facilitate testing of share dividend transactions via REST API calls. It encapsulates common API operations such as creating dividends, posting commands, and retrieving dividend information, mainly for integration testing purposes.

methods.name: createShareProductDividends
methods.description: Sends a POST request to create a share product dividend for a specified product ID using provided JSON data, utilizing the REST API. Deprecated; suggests rewriting to use a different client.

methods.name: postCommand
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to execute a specified command on a dividend identified by dividend ID, for a given share product, with provided JSON body. Deprecated; indicates it should be rewritten.

methods.name: retrieveDividendDetails
methods.description: Performs a GET request to fetch detailed information about a specific dividend for a given share product. Deprecated; suggests rewriting with a different client.

methods.name: retrieveAllDividends
methods.description: Performs a GET request to retrieve all dividends for a specific share product. Deprecated; recommends rewriting.
